thesis: PRE-MARKET read on Friday 2026-08-28, building the plan for today's regular session on the completed 8/27 bar and updating only what carries into the open. The picture is the same structurally-strong, internally-hollow tape the after-hours read left, with the dealer map firming slightly. SPY sits 771.1 on a full 20>50>200 bull-stack (+2.36% over its 50-day ~753.4, +9.07% over its 200-day ~707.0, mom126/252 +12.46%/+20.85%, pctFrom52wHigh -0.87, about 0.9% under its high) and swing-structure-lab still reads Bull-stacked (20>50>200) with the Double top below-threshold in an Unknown regime (fast 768.1, slow 709.41) — the structural leg is intact. But breadth is still very narrow: market-heatmap-lab reads 17.88% of 134 (margin -42.12), so counting distinct completed market-bar dates the last three are 44.72% on 8/25, 41.72% on 8/26 and 17.88% on 8/27, none above 60% and deteriorating, so three-bar persistence above 60% is not established. The dealer walls lifted: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab read SPY in POSITIVE gamma with the flip up at 768.83, spot 771.07 above it between the 770 put wall and a 772 call wall, signed net GEX +2.72B, atmIV 11.82% and a tight expected move of ±3.37 — pin-to-maxpain / patient, with slightly more room to the call wall than yesterday. Leadership stays tilted to Leading materials (XLB the highest sector rsMom) and re-strengthening energy (XLE back to Leading) funded from now-peaking tech (XLK) and weakening financials/healthcare (XLF/XLV). QQQ 721.11 holds its reclaimed 50-day while SPMO 148.6 is still fractionally below its 50-day though +13.15% over its 200-day; MSFT firmed to 505.06 with its trailing mom252 now +1.43. VIX is an easy 14.49 and volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (throttle x1.37). The plan carries forward: HOLD the intact core and the first beta-add tranche while pausing the rest until breadth re-broadens and holds 60% across three bars and SPMO reclaims its 50-day, keep the rotation tilt toward materials and re-strengthening energy, and HOLD (not chase) the firmer MSFT. Today's only scheduled catalyst is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision (medium).
